content: THE COUNCIL OF ELROND 257 whispered. ‘“The Nine are abroad again. They have crossed the River secretly and are moving westward. They have taken the guise of riders in black.” ‘I knew then what I had dreaded without knowing it. ‘*“The Enemy must have some great need or purpose,” said Radagast; ““but what it is that makes him look to these distant and desolate parts, I cannot guess.” “*“What do you mean?”’ said I. ‘“T have been told that wherever they go the Riders ask for news of a land called Shire.”’ ‘
